title: ScanRecord
description: One item read by the drone, as sent to the backend. Owned by this repo (format) and the app team (database). Changes need approval from both CODEOWNERS groups; see contracts/README.md for versioning rules.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Major version 1; minor versions only add optional fields.

scan_id.description: UUID generated on the drone. Idempotency key: the backend upserts on it.

mission_id.description: Identifier of the flight that produced the read.

timestamp.description: Detection time, RFC 3339 in UTC, for example 2026-10-20T14:03:22.512Z.

code.description: Decoded payload. AprilTags use <family>:<id>, for example tag36h11:17.

slot_code.description: Rack slot the item was attributed to; null when unattributed.

position_map.description: Label position in the warehouse map frame (ENU, metres); null when unknown.

attribution_method.description: label: a location label/tag was seen in the same or a nearby frame. pose: SLAM pose only. none: not attributed.

image_ref.description: Optional reference to a stored image crop (URI or object key).
